audience: General audiences who enjoy imaginative, emotionally meaningful cinematic stories
tone: Original, cinematic, intelligent, warm and suspenseful, PG / family-safe
visual_style: Original filmic images, crisp framing, consistent character wardrobe, controlled indigo-and-amber color palette, no celebrity likenesses, no embedded text
narrator: Warm English narrator using one approved persistent voice ID and fixed settings
continuity_rule: Each original series has a locked bible and an approved-only canon ledger. Always review both before scripting another part.
